statement.id: Yaksha merupakan kelompok roh alam dalam mitologi Hindu yang berkaitan dengan air, pepohonan, hutan, harta, dan kesuburan.
statement.en: Yakshas are a class of nature spirits in Hindu mythology associated with water, trees, forests, treasure, and fertility.

historical_basis.quote: In Buddhist literature, the yakṣa are the attendants of Vaiśravaṇa, the guardian of the northern quarter, a beneficent god who protects the righteous. The term also refers to the Twelve Heavenly Generals who guard Bhaiṣajyaguru, the Medicine Buddha. The yakshas of many Buddhist stories are ugly ogres, reborn in that form because of sins committed during their past lives as humans.

statement.id: Dalam literatur Buddhis, yaksha menjadi pengiring Vaisravana, penjaga arah utara.
statement.en: In Buddhist literature yakshas attend Vaisravana, guardian of the northern quarter.

Exactly two arms with two hands, two legs with two feet; palms and soles blue-black. Show open hands partly forward to read dark palms. Simple opaque brown waist wrap for modesty. Fully uncropped head-to-feet silhouette, entire tusks and beak visible, all fingers countable, comfortable margin. Deep ancient Indian forest with palms and mossy rocks establishes tall stature without adding humans. Formidable territorial predatory forest spirit in a poised watchful stance, not attacking. Premium detailed painterly folklore-book illustration, dark forest greens and walnut hair, restrained copper twilight, preserve blue-black palms and purple belly details. No horns, wings, extra heads or limbs, axe, held weapons, costumes from Thai Ramakien, victim, blood, text, watermark or border. One explicitly named yaksha subtype, not generic mixed demon imagery.
